name: notion_comment_create
description: Create a comment in a page or existing discussion thread (POST /v1/comments)

parent_id.description: The page or block the comment is attached to (parent.page_id). Either parent_id or discussion_id must be provided.

discussion_id.description: The ID of an existing discussion thread to add the comment to.

rich_text.description: The comment text content (rich_text, flattened to plain text).
